description.value: The Bridge is a Korean fine dining restaurant in West Vancouver that brings the warmth of Korean family dinner traditions to a candlelit dining room where every table is intentionally different, reflecting the belief that all families are unique. The chef draws on 20 years of fine-dining experience and sources fresh ingredients from local farmers' markets to serve seasonal, soulful Korean cuisine. Both dine-in and takeout are available.
